## `logging`

Configures a named, independently-routed log destination (e.g. database queries, the message queue) — anything that just needs a level, a rotating file, and a JSON/text choice. See server/logging.New, which routes records tagged with a given name to their own destination when one is configured.

## `logging.*`

Log-file rotation for this destination, via the embedded timberjack logger, with the same keys and meanings as logging.* above. This destination is only split out of the main log once its filename is set; until then its records go to the general log.

## `logging.level`

`string`, default `empty`

The minimum log level for this destination, in the same form as logging.level.

## `logging.add_source`

`bool`, default `false`

Includes the source file and line on each record.

```yaml
queue:
  logging:
    add_source: false
```

## `logging.log_json`

`bool`, default `false`

Writes JSON instead of text. Text is meant to be read, not parsed: the message is written as bare prose so quoted values in it are not escaped, which is not a machine-readable format. Set this wherever a log collector has to pull fields back out.

```yaml
queue:
  logging:
    log_json: false
```
